exactBranchAddition:
# Preserve the canonical storage fault response for an existing source.
      # A failed rendition write does not establish that the media is missing.
      {:error, :storage_unavailable} = refused ->
        env = Errors.to_envelope(refused, conn)

        conn
        |> put_status(env.status)
        |> json(%{error: Map.delete(env, :status)})
scope: Only shared serve_rendition_file explicit storage_unavailable branch delegates to existing Errors envelope503. Admission tuple/unknown preset/generic backend404 branches unchanged. No schema/authorization/render/storage/journal behavior change.
limits: Private unadopted controller source only. No runtime HTTP behavior yet, production source/app/pin/installer frozen. Existing storage503 is a public HTTP contract, not permission to recover/reconcile/retry uncertain effects.
